routing_contract_difference: Source-attested owner-frame routing additionally skips f_code audits and thread/owner/ancestor checks and listener delivery on eligible nonhook lines. Call, hooks, exception, first exception-resume line and return/yield retain original delivery; each return/yield expires the local segment and a real resume call rebinds. Transient skipped-line identity/locals/metadata drift restored before a retained boundary may evade detection. Actual event equivalence does not imply predecessor per-line integrity sampling equality.
